Ulandelelwano lokufunda olucingelwayo: abafundi osele befunde ii-equation zekhwadratiki, ukungalingani kwekhwadratiki, nobudlelwane phakathi kwee-roots namakoyifishenti.
z-m-23-05.title: Kutheni x + y = 6, xy = 8 inezibini ezi-2 zezisombululo, kunye nemeko enesibini e-1
z-m-23-05.topic: Inani lezisombululo zoqhagamshelwano oluhambelanayo olunesixa nesiphumo esinikiweyo
z-m-23-05.goal: Qonda ukuba kuqhagamshelwano apho x no-y banoxanduva olufanayo izisombululo ziza ngezibini ezilandelelanayo, nesohlukileyo (x = y), uze wenze umzekelo onesibini e-1 sesisombululo kanye wena.
z-m-23-05.material: Kuqhagamshelwano olulandelayo, x no-y ngamanani anyanisekileyo yaye izisombululo zibalwa njengezibini ezilandelelanayo (x, y). "(2, 4)" ithetha "x ngu-2, y ngu-4" yaye sisibini esilandelelanayo esahlukileyo ku-(4, 2). Uqhagamshelwano: x + y = 6, xy = 8. Sicinga nangenani lezisombululo zoqhagamshelwano lohlobo x + y = s, xy = p (s no-p ngamanani aphelele) ngokubanzi.
z-m-23-05.prereq.1: Ukuziqhelanisa noqhagamshelwano lwekhwadrathi olunokusonjululwa ngokufaka ibinzana lomgca kwibinzana lekhwadrathi
z-m-23-05.prereq.2: Intsingiselo yesibini esilandelelanayo ((2, 4) no-(4, 2) zizibini ezilandelelanayo ezahlukileyo)
z-m-23-05.s.s1.prompt: Zingaphi izibini zezibini ezilandelelanayo ezinyanisekileyo (x, y) ezinelisa x + y = 6 no-xy = 8 zombini?
z-m-23-05.s.s1.hint.0: Faka u-2, 4, 3 endaweni ka-x omnye emva komnye, ukhethe y ukuze isixa sibe ngu-6, uze uhlole ukuba ulingano lwesi-2 xy = 8 luyabamba na.
z-m-23-05.s.s1.hint.1: Lungisa kwitheyibhile ukuba (2, 4), (4, 2), no-(2, 2) nganye inelisa ulingano zombini na.
z-m-23-05.s.s1.r.a: Olu gwebo lubala izibini ezi-2 ezilandelelanayo ezinamaxabiso ka-x no-y atshintshiweyo njengezisombululo ezahlukeneyo.
z-m-23-05.s.s1.r.b: (2, 4) ithetha "x ngu-2, y ngu-4" yaye (4, 2) ithetha "x ngu-4, y ngu-2". Hlola ukuba amaxabiso ka-x no-y kulingano olubini ayahluka na.
z-m-23-05.s.s1.o.c: Izibini ezi-4: faka u-2 no-4 ngokukhululekileyo kuma-x no-y
z-m-23-05.s.s1.r.c: Faka (2, 2) no-(4, 4) kulingano olubini uze uhlole ukuba isixa si-6 na.
z-m-23-05.s.s1.r.d: Ulingano ngalunye ngokwalo lunezisombululo ezingapheliyo, kodwa zingaphi izibini ezanelisa ulingano zombini ngaxeshanye kufuneka zisetyenzwe ngokwahlukileyo.
z-m-23-05.s.s1.explain: Xa x imiselwe, y imiselwa ngumqathango wesixa y = 6 − x, yaye ukusuka kwi-xy = 8, x(6 − x) = 8, oko kukuthi, (x − 2)(x − 4) = 0. Xa x = 2, y = 4, yaye xa x = 4, y = 2, ngoko izibini ezilandelelanayo zizibini ezi-2 (2, 4) no-(4, 2). (2, 2) no-(4, 4) azinaso isixa se-6, ngoko azizizo izisombululo.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.prompt: UMina wacinga ngenani lezisombululo zoqhagamshelwano lohlobo x + y = s, xy = p ngolu hlobo. Ngumgca ofanayo ophosakele wokuqala?
z-m-23-05.s.s2.hint.0: Faka (3, 3) kwimigca e-3 neyesi-4 kulingano olubini ukuhlola ukuba isebenza, uze uthelekise nebango lemigca e-1 neyesi-2.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.hint.1: Fumanisa ukuba ngaba kukho iimeko apho (a, b) no-(b, a), ngocwangciso olutshintshiweyo, bayisibini esilandelelanayo esifanayo, nokuba ubudlelwane obuthini phakathi kuka-a no-b buyenza kube njalo.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.line.0: x + y = s, xy = p azitshintshi nokuba x no-y batshintshiwe. Ngoko ukuba (a, b) sisisombululo, (b, a) naso sisisombululo.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.line.1: Ngoko izisombululo ziza ngezibini zika-(a, b) no-(b, a) kuphela, yaye inani lezisombululo lihlala lilinganayo.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.line.2: Umzekelo, kwi-x + y = 6, xy = 9, ukufaka y = 6 − x kwi-xy = 9 kunika x(6 − x) = 9, oko kukuthi, (x − 3)² = 0.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.line.3: Emva koko x = 3, y = 3, ngoko isisombululo sisibini e-1 (3, 3).
z-m-23-05.s.s2.line.4: Kufanele ukuba ilingane kodwa sisibini e-1, ngoko ukubala komgca o-3 kuphosakele.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.explain: Umgca o-2 ngowokuqala ophosakeleyo. (a, b) no-(b, a) sisibini esilandelelanayo esifanayo xa a = b, ngoko abenzi sibini. Umgca o-3 wabalwa ngokuchanekileyo njenge-(x − 3)² = 0, yaye (3, 3) yanelisa ulingano zombini (3 + 3 = 6, 3 · 3 = 9). Ngoko isigqibo somgca o-5 siphosakele nasona.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.prompt: Kwi-x + y = s, xy = p (s no-p ngamanani aphelele), yenza uqhagamshelwano oluyi-3 olwahlukileyo olunesibini e-1 kuphela sezisombululo ezinyanisekileyo (x, y). Emva kokuba usenzile, chaza ukuba kutheni kukho isibini e-1 kuphela.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.hint.0: Ukuba kukho isibini e-1 kuphela, (a, b) no-(b, a), ngocwangciso olutshintshiweyo, kufuneka babe sisibini esifanayo. Bhala ukuba ubudlelwane obuthini phakathi kuka-a no-b buyafuneka.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.hint.1: Bala isixa nesiphumo sika-x, y ngolo budlelwane (umzekelo, x = y = 3) uze ugqibe s no-p.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.fail.c1: Nceda ufake s no-p njengamanani aphelele.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.fail.c2: Akukho sibini e-1 sezisombululo. Kukho izibini ezi-2 ze-(x, y) ezinyanisekileyo ezanelisa ulingano zombini, okanye akukho nanye.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.explain: Ukuba kukho isibini e-1 kuphela, x = y, ngoko s = 2x, p = x², kwaye s² = 4p. Imizekelo: (s, p) = (2, 1) → (1, 1), (4, 4) → (2, 2), (−6, 9) → (−3, −3), (0, 0) → (0, 0). (6, 8) inezibini ezi-2, (2, 4) kunye no-(4, 2), kwaye (2, 5) ayinazisombululo ezinyanisekileyo (zizisombululo ezintsonkothileyo kuphela). Kufana nokuthi ulingano lwekhwadrathi t² − st + p = 0 lunengcambu ephindiweyo.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.prompt: Usebenzisa uxanduva luka-x no-y, chaza ukuba kutheni uqhagamshelwano osandula ukwenza lunesibini e-1 kuphela sezisombululo.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.hint.0: Bhala oko ulingano olubini luba kuko xa x no-y batshintshiwe.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.hint.1: Bhala ukuba ubudlelwane obuthini (a, b) no-(b, a) banabo xa kukho isibini e-1 kuphela sezisombululo.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.placeholder: Umzekelo: Nokuba sitshintsha x no-y, ... ngoko ...
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubhale umqathango apho (a, b) no-(b, a) bafana khona?
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uhlole ukuba s no-p owenzileyo bunxulumene njani nalo mqathango?
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.model.0: Nokuba sitshintsha x no-y, ulingano luhlala lunjalo, ngoko ukuba (a,b) sisisombululo, (b,a) naso sisisombululo. Ukuze kubekho isibini e-1 kuphela, izisombululo ezi-2 kufuneka zifane, ngoko kuphela imeko a=b, oko kukuthi x=y.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.model.1: Ukuba isisombululo (a, b), ngoko (b, a), ngocwangciso olutshintshiweyo, nayo sisisombululo, ngoko zihlala ziza ngezibini. Ukuze kubekho isibini e-1 kuphela, amanani amabini kufuneka afane, ngoko kuphela imeko s=2x, p=x² isebenza.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.modelNote.1: Ixhume yonke indlela ukuya kulingano nga-s no-p.

z-m-23-01.title: x⁴ + x² − 6 = 0: ukuhlola isisombululo esithi zikho ii-roots ezine zangempela
z-m-23-01.topic: Ukugweba inani lee-roots zangempela ze-equation yequartic ngendlela yekhwadratiki kwi-x²
z-m-23-01.goal: Kwi-equation yequartic esonjululwe ngokuvumela i-x² ibe unobumba omtsha, hlola uluhlu apho ixabiso lonobumba omtsha linokunika i-x yangempela ukufumana impazamo kwisisombululo, uze ucacise iimeko apho iimpawu zamakoyifishenti zodwa zigqiba inani lee-roots zangempela.
z-m-23-01.material: U-Yeongseo wasombulula i-equation yequartic x⁴ + x² − 6 = 0 ukufumana zonke izisombululo zayo zangempela (ii-roots zangempela). Apha, ii-roots zangempela zithetha kuphela izisombululo ezizinani langempela, kwaye izisombululo ze-imaginary azibalwa. (x⁴ ifundwa "x ukuya kwesine" kwaye x² ifundwa "x isikwere".)
z-m-23-01.prereq.0: I-H1 kulo msebenzi ibonisa kuphela ubunzima bolu didi lwemveliso; ayithethi ukuba ikharityhulam inikela esi sixhobo kwibanga lesikolo samabanga aphezulu elingu-1. Ulandelelwano lokufunda olucingelwayo: abafundi osele befunde ii-equation zekhwadratiki, ukungalingani kwekhwadratiki, nobudlelwane phakathi kwee-roots namakoyifishenti.
z-m-23-01.prereq.1: Ukuziqhelanisa nokusombulula ngokuhlela intetho yekhwadratiki kwi-x²
z-m-23-01.prereq.2: Ukugweba iimpawu usebenzisa isixa nemveliso yee-roots ezimbini ze-equation yekhwadratiki
z-m-23-01.prereq.3: Ukwahlula amanani angempela kunye ne-imaginary (akukho nani langempela linika ixabiso elingalunganga xa lisikwere)
z-m-23-01.s.s1.prompt: Ngowuphi umgca kwisisombululo sika-Yeongseo owokuqala ongachanekanga? Khetha umgca omnye. (Iimpazamo ezilandelayo kuwo zichazwa kunye kwingcaciso.)
z-m-23-01.s.s1.hint.0: Faka ixabiso elisuka kumgca ngamnye ngqo kwi-equation yantlandlolo x⁴ + x² − 6 uze uhlole omnye ngomnye ukuba iba ngu-0 na.
z-m-23-01.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ngoluhlu lwamaxabiso anokuthathwa yi-x² endaweni ka-t kwi-x yangempela, uze uthelekise umgca 3 nomgca 4.
z-m-23-01.s.s1.line.0: Ukuvumela i-x² ibe ngu-t kunika t² + t − 6 = 0.
z-m-23-01.s.s1.line.3: Ukusuka kwi-x² = −3, x = ±√3, kwaye ukusuka kwi-x² = 2, x = ±√2.
z-m-23-01.s.s1.explain: Umgca 4 owokuqala ongachanekanga. Inani langempela x ubuncinane li-0 xa lisikwere, ngoko akukho x yangempela ene-x² = −3. Ngoko ±√3 ayizizo ii-roots zangempela (ukuba ufaka x = √3 kwi-equation yantlandlolo, 9 + 3 − 6 = 6 ≠ 0). "Ezine" kumgca 5 nazo azichanekanga ngenxa yoku, kwaye ii-roots zangempela zimbini, −√2 no-√2. Imigca 1 ukuya kwi-3 ichanekile.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.prompt: Kumanani apheleleyo p no-q, kwi-x⁴ + px² + q = 0, ukuba uyazi kuphela ukuba q < 0 kwaye awuyazi p, zingaphi ii-roots zangempela ezahlukileyo?
z-m-23-01.s.s2.hint.0: Bala uze uthelekise ii-roots zangempela kwii-equation ezintathu apho q ifana ne-−4 kwaye p yi-−5, 0, 3.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala njenge-equation ukuba imveliso yee-roots ezimbini ze-equation yekhwadratiki kwi-t=x² inxulumana njani no-q, uze uhlole uphawu.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.o.a: 4: ixabiso ngalinye kwamabini e-x² linika ii-x ezimbini zangempela
z-m-23-01.s.s2.r.a: Ixabiso apho i-x² ingalunganga alinikezi x yangempela. Qala ujonge uphawu lwamaxabiso anokuthathwa yi-x².
z-m-23-01.s.s2.o.b: 2: ixabiso elinye kuphela kwe-x² linika i-x yangempela
z-m-23-01.s.s2.r.b: Esi sigwebo sisebenza ukuba amaxabiso amabini e-x² anaziphi iimpawu.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.o.c: 0: x⁴ kunye ne-x² ubuncinane zi-0, ngoko isixa sazo asinakuba ngu-0
z-m-23-01.s.s2.r.c: Ukuba ufaka x = 0, ixabiso lentetho yi-q, engalunganga. Jonga utshintsho lophawu ukubona ukuba likho na indawo apho ixabiso lentetho li-0.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.o.d: Akunakwaziwa: ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso lika-p, yenye ye-0, 2, okanye 4
z-m-23-01.s.s2.r.d: Esi sigwebo sicinga ukuba ixabiso lika-p liyafuneka. Kodwa qala uhlole ukuba ikho inyaniso emiselwe ngu-q < 0 kuphela nokuba p yintoni.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.explain: Imveliso yee-roots ezimbini ze-t² + pt + q = 0 kunye ne-t = x² yi-q < 0, ngoko eyona yinye iyongezelelo kwaye enye ayilunganga (i-discriminant p² − 4q nayo ihlala iyongezelelo). I-t eyongezelelo kuphela inika ii-x ezimbini zangempela, ngoko nokuba p yintoni, zikho ii-roots ezi-2 zangempela ezahlukileyo.
z-m-23-01.s.s3.prompt: Cacisa, usebenzisa uphawu lwe-t (= x²), ukuba kutheni zikho ii-roots ezi-2 zangempela nokuba p yintoni xa q < 0, uze unike umzekelo omnye ngamanani apho inani lee-roots zangempela lixhomekeke kwi-p xa q > 0.
z-m-23-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale kwisivakalisi esinye inyaniso yokuba imveliso yee-roots ezimbini ze-t yi-q nophawu luka-q.
z-m-23-01.s.s3.hint.1: Njengemizekelo ye-q > 0, sombulula p = −5, q = 4 no-p = 1, q = 1 uze ubale ii-roots zangempela, uze ubhale enye yazo.
z-m-23-01.s.s3.placeholder: Umzekelo: Ukuba q < 0, imveliso yee-roots ezimbini ze-t yi-... ngoko ...
z-m-23-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba usebenzise inyaniso yokuba ii-roots ezimbini ze-t zineempawu ezahlukileyo xa q < 0 njengesizathu?
z-m-23-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ubhale unxibelelwano "i-t eyongezelelo kuphela inika i-x yangempela"?
z-m-23-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba usombulule umzekelo we-q > 0 owunikiweyo wahlola inani lee-roots zangempela?
z-m-23-01.s.s3.model.0: q yimveliso yee-roots ezimbini ze-t²+pt+q=0 kwaye ayilunganga, ngoko i-t enye iyongezelelo kwaye enye ayilunganga. Ukusuka kwi-x²=eyongezelelo kukho ii-x ezimbini zangempela, kwaye ukusuka kwi-x²=engalunganga akukho x yangempela, ngoko zihlala zikho ii-roots ezi-2 zangempela. Ukuba q>0, i-x⁴−5x²+4=0 ine-t=1, 4, ngoko ii-roots ezi-4 zangempela, kodwa i-x⁴+x²+1=0 ayinazo ii-roots zangempela.
z-m-23-01.s.s3.model.1: Ukuba uvumela t=x², imveliso yee-roots ezimbini ayilunganga, ngoko iimpawu zazo ziyahluka. I-t engalunganga ayinakuvela kwisikwere, ngoko ii-x ezimbini kuphela ezisuka kwi-t eyongezelelo ziii-roots zangempela. Nokuba q iyongezelelo, ixhomekeke kwi-p: ngo-p=−2, q=1 zikho ii-roots ezi-2 zangempela, kwaye ngo-p=3, q=2 zikho ii-roots ezi-0 zangempela.

z-m-23-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Nceda uthathe m no-n njengamanani apheleleyo.
z-m-23-02.prereq.0: I-H1 kulo msebenzi ibonisa kuphela ubunzima bolu didi lwemveliso; ayithethi ukuba ikharityhulam inikela esi sixhobo kwibanga lesikolo samabanga aphezulu elingu-1. Ulandelelwano lokufunda olucingelwayo: abafundi osele befunde ii-equation zekhwadratiki, ukungalingani kwekhwadratiki, nobudlelwane phakathi kwee-roots namakoyifishenti.
z-m-23-02.title: Ukuba i-root enye yi-1 + i, ingaba enye i-root imisiwe?
z-m-23-02.topic: Iimeko ezifunekayo ukumisela enye i-root kwi-equation yekhwadratiki ene-root ye-imaginary
z-m-23-02.goal: Hlula ulwazi oluyimfuneko nolo lungekhoyo lokumisela enye i-root xa i-root enye iyi-imaginary, uze wenze imizekelo yakho echasayo apho amakoyifishenti engenakuba ngamanani angempela.
z-m-23-02.material: I-root enye ye-equation yekhwadratiki x² + px + q = 0 yi-1 + i. (i linani eliyisikwere salo li-−1 kwaye lifundwa "eye".) U-Mina wathi, "Enye i-root yi-1 − i," kwaye u-Doyun wathi, "Oko kuphela akunakumisela enye i-root." Akukabikho ukuthiwa p no-q ziinani zohlobo luni.
z-m-23-02.prereq.1: Ukudibanisa nokuphindaphinda amanani abumbeneyo, inxalenye yangempela nenxalenye ye-imaginary
z-m-23-02.prereq.2: Ubudlelwane bokuba isixa see-roots ezimbini ze-equation yekhwadratiki si-−p kwaye imveliso yi-q
z-m-23-02.prereq.3: Intsingiselo ye-discriminant (iintlobo zee-roots xa amakoyifishenti engangempela)
z-m-23-02.s.s1.prompt: Ngaphandle kwenyaniso yokuba i-root enye ye-equation yekhwadratiki x² + px + q = 0 yi-1 + i, ngowuphi ulwazi olongezelelweyo olwaluya kumisela enye i-root ibe yinye kanye? Khetha lonke ulwazi olulimisa ngaloo ndlela.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kukhetho ngalunye, jonga omnye ngomnye ngamanani umzekelo oanelisa le meko kodwa une-root eyahlukileyo.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.hint.1: Sebenzisa ubudlelwane bokuba isixa see-roots ezimbini si-−p ukubhala ngqo enye i-root kukhetho ngalunye.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.r.a: Inyaniso yokuba isixa singesangempela yodwa ayinakuncitshisa enye i-root ibe yinye. Bhala enye i-root xa isixa si-3 nexa isixa si-2.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.r.b: Esi sigwebo siyazi ukuba imeko ngamakoyifishenti ilinganisela njani imilo yee-roots.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.r.c: Ukusuka ekubeni i-discriminant ingalunganga yodwa, awunakwazi ukuthi ii-roots ziza ngebini na. Bala i-discriminant yemeko apho ii-roots zi-1 + i kunye ne-1.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.r.d: Esi sigwebo sisebenzisa ubudlelwane bokuba isixa see-roots ezimbini si-−p.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.explain: Ukuba p no-q zangempela, i-root ye-imaginary ibhanyela kunye ne-conjugate yayo yenani elibumbeneyo, ngoko enye i-root imiselwe njenge-1 − i. Nokwazi ixabiso lika-p kumisela enye i-root kuba isixa si-−p (ukuba p = −3, ngoko 3 − (1 + i) = 2 − i). Ulwazi lokuba isixa singesangempela aluhlali lwanele, kuba enye i-root ingaba yi-1 − i okanye i-2 − i. Nokuba i-discriminant ayilunganga, kukho imeko apho ii-roots zi-1 + i kunye ne-1 (p = −(2 + i), q = 1 + i, p² − 4q = −1), ngoko ayimiswanga.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.prompt: Ukubhala enye i-root njenge-m + ni (m no-n ziinani ezipheleleyo), yenza imizekelo emi-3 eyahlukileyo apho p ingangempela kodwa q ingengangempela. (Isixa see-roots ezimbini si-−p kwaye imveliso yi-q. i linani eliyisikwere salo li-−1.)
z-m-23-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubhale ukuba inxalenye ye-imaginary yesixa see-roots ezimbini (1 + i) + (m + ni) kufuneka ibe lixabiso eliphi ukuze p ibe yangempela.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ngo-n oanelisa imeko yenxalenye ye-imaginary, andisa imveliso (1 + i)(m + ni), ufumane m eyenza inxalenye ye-imaginary ibe ngu-0, uze ugweme loo m.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Isixa see-roots ezimbini (1 + m) + (1 + n)i asingesangempela. p ayingeyangempela nayo.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Inxalenye ye-imaginary yemveliso yee-roots ezimbini ayingo-0, ngoko q ayingeyangempela.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Inxalenye ye-imaginary yemveliso yee-roots ezimbini (m − n) + (m + n)i ingu-0, ngoko q yangempela.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.explain: Ukuze isixa sibe sangempela, inxalenye ye-imaginary 1 + n kufuneka ibe ngu-0, ngoko n = −1. Emva koko imveliso yi-(m + 1) + (m − 1)i, ngoko ukuba m ≠ 1, q ayingeyangempela. Umzekelo: ukuba enye i-root yi-2 − i, ngoko p = −3 (yangempela) kwaye q = (1 + i)(2 − i) = 3 + i (ayingeyangempela). Ukuba m = 1, enye i-root yi-1 − i kwaye q = 2, eyangempela.
z-m-23-02.s.s3.prompt: Cacisela umhlobo. Ungathini ngenye i-root ye-equation yekhwadratiki enee-root enye i-1 + i, xa kukho isitatimenti esithi "amakoyifishenti p no-q ayangempela" nexa kungekho?
z-m-23-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale kwisivakalisi esinye enye i-root xa kukho imeko yokuba amakoyifishenti ayangempela.
z-m-23-02.s.s3.hint.1: Xa kungekho meko, khumbula umzekelo owenze ngaphambili (i-2 − i njalo njalo) uze ubhale kwisivakalisi esinye ukuba enye i-root ayikuphela kokunokwenzeka.

z-m-23-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uyalazi ubuncinane umzekelo omnye (umzekelo, i-2 − i okanye i-1) onokuba yenye i-root xa kungekho meko?
z-m-23-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba udibanise ngamagama akho ukuba kutheni imeko "amakoyifishenti ayangempela" iyafuneka?
z-m-23-02.s.s3.model.0: Ukuba p no-q zangempela, i-root ye-imaginary ibhanyela kunye ne-conjugate yayo, ngoko enye i-root yi-1−i. Ukuba akukho sitatimenti esinjalo, zikho iindlela ezininzi ezinokwenzeka njenge-2−i okanye i-1, ngoko enye i-root ayinakumiselwa.
z-m-23-02.s.s3.model.1: Ukuba amakoyifishenti angangempela, inani elibumbeneyo le-conjugate i-1−i ye-1+i yenye i-root. Ukuba akukho meko kumakoyifishenti, inokutshintsha, njenge-2−i ukuba isixa si-3 kunye ne-1−i ukuba isixa si-2, ngoko asinakuthi liyixabiso elinye.

z-m-23-06.title: Ukusombulula (x − 2)(x − 5) = 3(x − 2) ngokuhlula macala omabini
z-m-23-06.topic: Iimeko apho isisombululo siphosiswa kulingano olunesiphinda esifanayo macala omabini
z-m-23-06.goal: Qonda ukuba kutheni, kulingano apho isiphinda esifanayo siphindaphindwa macala omabini, imeko apho eso siphinda singu-0 kufuneka ihlolwe ngokwahlukileyo, uze ukhethe wenze ulingano apho indlela yokusombulula iphosisa izisombululo nolo lungenzi njalo.
z-m-23-06.material: Umfundi wasombulula ulingano (x − 2)(x − 5) = 3(x − 2). x linani elinyanisekileyo yaye izisombululo nazo zinqunyelwe kumanani anyanisekileyo. (Indlela yokufunda: "x kuthabathwa 2 amaxesha x kuthabathwa 5 kulingana nama-3 amaxesha x kuthabathwa 2".)
z-m-23-06.thinking.2: Ukwenza imizekelo echasayo (imizekelo apho isisombululo siphosiswa) wena
z-m-23-06.prereq.2: Ukuhlola isisombululo solingano ngokusifaka kulingano lokuqala
z-m-23-06.s.s1.prompt: Umfundi wasombulula ulingano (x − 2)(x − 5) = 3(x − 2) ngolu hlobo lungezantsi. Ngumgca ofanayo wokuqala onengxaki?
z-m-23-06.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ukuba ukubala kuni kwavelisa umgca ngamnye wesisombululo kumgca wangaphambili, uze uhlole ukuba oko kubala kunokusetyenziswa kuwo onke ama-x na.
z-m-23-06.s.s1.hint.1: Xa uhlula, bhala ukuba ixabiso lomhluli akufuneki libe yintoni, uze uhlole ukuba eli xabiso linokwenzeka kwi-x kule ngxaki na.
z-m-23-06.s.s1.line.1: Ukuhlula macala omabini nge-(x − 2) kunika x − 5 = 3.
z-m-23-06.s.s1.line.3: Ukufaka x = 8 kulingano lokuqala kunika 6 · 3 = 18 kwaye 3 · 6 = 18, ngoko iyabamba.
z-m-23-06.s.s1.line.4: Ngoko isisombululo kuphela salolu lingano ngu-x = 8.
z-m-23-06.s.s1.explain: Ingxaki iqala ukuvela kumgca o-2. Ukuba x = 2, ngoko x − 2 ngu-0, ngoko kuyafana nokuhlula nge-0. Ukuba ufaka x = 2 kulingano lokuqala, macala omabini angu-0, ngoko x = 2 nayo sisisombululo. Ukuhlolwa komgca o-4 kubonisa kuphela ukuba x = 8 sisisombululo yaye akuthethi ukuba akukho zinye izisombululo. Ngoko "kuphela" komgca o-5 kuphosakele, yaye izisombululo zangempela ngu-2 no-8.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.prompt: Ulingano olulandelayo zonke zinesiphinda esifanayo (x − 1) esiphindaphindwe macala omabini. Loluphi olungalahlekelwa sisisombululo nasinye xa lusonjululwa ngokuhlula macala omabini nge-(x − 1)?
z-m-23-06.s.s2.hint.0: Faka x = 1 ngqo kulingano ngalunye uze uhlole ukuba macala omabini alinganayo na.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kulingano ngalunye, linganisa amabinzana amabini ashiyekileyo emva kokususa (x − 1) uze uthelekise ukuba isisombululo sawo si-1 na.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.r.a: Olu gwebo luthelekise ukuba x = 1 sisisombululo nokuba iphakathi na kwizisombululo zebinzana elishiyekileyo emva kokuhlula.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.r.b: Faka x = 1 ukubona ukuba macala omabini angu-0 na, uze uthelekise ukuba isisombululo sebinzana elishiyekileyo emva kokuhlula, x + 2 = 4, si-1 na.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.r.c: x = 1 sisisombululo, kodwa isisombululo kuphela sebinzana elishiyekileyo emva kokuhlula, 3 = x + 4, ngu-−1.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.r.d: x = 1 sisisombululo, kodwa isisombululo kuphela sebinzana elishiyekileyo emva kokuhlula, x − 3 = 2, ngu-5.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.explain: Kuzo zonke ulingano olune, ukufaka x = 1 kwenza macala omabini abe ngu-0, ngoko x = 1 sisisombululo. Ukuba isisombululo solingano olushiyekileyo emva kokuhlula si-1, akukho sisombululo siphosiswa. a inika u-2 ukusuka kwi-x + 2 = 4, b inika u-−1 ukusuka kwi-3 = x + 4, kwaye c inika u-5 ukusuka kwi-x − 3 = 2, ngoko zonke ziphosa x = 1. d inika x = 1 ukusuka kwi-x + 3 = 4, ngoko akukho sisombululo siphosiswayo, kwaye ekubeni yi-(x − 1)² = 0, isisombululo kuphela si-1.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.prompt: Kulingano lohlobo (x − a)(x − b) = c(x − a) (a, b, c ngamanani aphelele asuka ku-−9 ukuya ku-9), yenza ulingano oluyi-3 olwahlukileyo apho indlela yokusombulula yokuhlula nge-(x − a) iphosisa isisombululo e-1. Ulingano olufanayo olubhalwe ngokwahlukileyo (a efanayo kwaye b + c efanayo) lubalwa njengomzekelo ofanayo.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.hint.0: Kuqala khetha a uze uhlole ukuba x = a sisisombululo solingano lokuqala, emva koko khetha b no-c ukuze isisombululo se-x − b = c, esifunyenwe ngokulinganisa izinto eziseleyo, sahluke ku-a.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.hint.1: Xa wenza ii-(a, b, c) ezininzi, hlola ukuba ezo zine-a efanayo kunye no-b + c kuphela efanayo zilingano olufanayo, uze ukhethe a okanye b + c eyahlukileyo.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.fail.c2: a, b, c kufuneka zibe zisuka ku-−9 ukuya ku-9.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.ok.c3: x = a sisisombululo kodwa sahlukile kwisisombululo x = b + c solingano olushiyekileyo emva kokuhlula, ngoko siyaphoswa.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.fail.c3: x = a siyafana nesisombululo b + c solingano olushiyekileyo emva kokuhlula, ngoko akukho sisombululo siphoswayo.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.explain: (x − a)(x − b) = c(x − a) yi-(x − a)(x − b − c) = 0, ngoko izisombululo zi-x = a kunye no-x = b + c. Indlela yokwahlula ifumana kuphela x = b + c. Ukuba a ≠ b + c, isisombululo a siyaphoswa. Imizekelo: (a, b, c) = (2, 5, 3) → izisombululo 2 kunye no-8, (1, 4, 0) → 1 kunye no-4. Kwi-(2, −1, 3), b + c = 2 = a, ngoko isisombululo esiyedwa yi-2 kwaye akukho nto iphoswayo.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.prompt: Chaza ukuba isisombululo esiphoswayo lixabiso eliyintoni nokuba kutheni le ndlela yokusombulula ingenakusetyenziswa njengoko injalo kwelo xabiso.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.hint.0: Bhala ukuba ngeliphi ixabiso le-x ibinzana x − a lingu-0.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.hint.1: Bhala ukuba icala ngalinye liba yintoni xa ufaka loo x kwi-equation yokuqala.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubhale ngokuchanekileyo ukuba isisombululo esiphoswayo yi-x = a?
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Ingaba udibanise inyaniso yokuba x − a ingu-0 kuloo xabiso ne-"awunakwahlula nge-0"?
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.model.0: Isisombululo esiphoswayo yi-x=a. Ukuba x=a, ngoko x−a ingu-0 kwaye asinakwahlula nge-0, ngoko kufuneka sijonge loo meko ngokwahlukileyo.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.model.1: Isisombululo x=a, apho ifaktha eqhelekileyo x−a ingu-0, sisisombululo se-equation yokuqala, kodwa indlela yahlula ngebinzana elingu-0 apho, ngoko esi sisombululo siyanyamalala. Kufuneka ufake elo xabiso kwi-equation yokuqala ngokwahlukileyo.

z-m-23-03.title: Ibhola ephoswayo iphantsi nini, kwi-6 m okanye ngaphantsi?
z-m-23-03.topic: Ukusebenzisa ukungalingani kwekhwadratiki: ukucinga ngoluhlu lwenguquko nalo
z-m-23-03.goal: Kwimeko eyenziwe ngomzekelo wokungalingani kwekhwadratiki, ungawuthwali isisombululo sentetho njengempendulo njengoko injalo, kodwa uyihlalutye kunye noluhlu apho umzekelo usebenza khona, uze wenze amaxabiso aneemeko wena.
z-m-23-03.material: Ibhola yaphoswa phezulu isuka kubude obungu-1 m ngaphezu komhlaba. Ubude ii-t zesekhondi emva kokuphosa buphiwa yi-h(t) = −5t² + 20t + 1 (iyunithi: m), kwaye le ntetho inokusetyenziswa kuphela ngelixa ibhola indiza (ukusuka kumzuzu wokuphosa ukuya kumzuzu athinta ngawo umhlaba). Ungayihoyi ukumelana komoya.
z-m-23-03.thinking.0: Ukuphinda ujonge ingqikelelo yakho ngokuhamba phakathi kwetheyibhile nentetho
z-m-23-03.prereq.1: Ukusombulula ukungalingani kwekhwadratiki nokufunda iimpawu zokungalingani zesisombululo
z-m-23-03.s.s1.prompt: Ufuna ukufumanisa ukuba ubude bebhola ephoswayo buphantsi nini, kwi-6 m okanye ngaphantsi. Jonga ukuba isigwebo sakho sitshintsha njani rhoqo xa kuvezwa ulwazi.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.hint.0: Thelekisa ubude ngalo lonke ixesha kwitheyibhile ne-6 m uze uphawule imiqolo emi-6 m okanye ngaphantsi.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.hint.1: Faka amaxesha angekho kwitheyibhile (0.5 s, 3.5 s) kwintetho uze uhlole ukuba ubude bungu-6 m okanye ngaphantsi.

Ibhola yaphoswa phezulu isuka kubude obungu-1 m ngaphezu komhlaba. Ubude ii-t zesekhondi emva kokuphosa yi-h(t) = −5t² + 20t + 1 (iyunithi m), kwaye le ntetho inokusetyenziswa kuphela ngelixa ibhola indiza (ukusuka kumzuzu wokuphosa ukuya kumzuzu athinta ngawo umhlaba). Ubude ngamaxesha athile bungala.

z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ubude bungu-6 m okanye ngaphantsi nini emva kokuphosa? Jonga itheyibhile uze wenze uqikelelo kuqala.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Ukujonga itheyibhile, ubude buphantsi kwi-1 m kwi-0 s nakwi-4 s, kwaye i-16 m okanye ngaphezulu ukusuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-3 s. Ngoko kubonakala ukuba amaxesha aphantsi amabini, kufutshane nokuqala nakufutshane nokuphela. Kodwa itheyibhile ibonisa kuphela imizuzwana epheleleyo, ngoko udinga intetho ukufumanisa ngokuchanekileyo apho imida ikhona.

Umzekelo, t = 0 (1 m), 0.2 (4.8 m), 3.8 (4.8 m), 4 (1 m) zihambelana nemiqathango. t = 0.3 okanye 3.7 inika 6.55 m, ongaphezu kwama-6 m, kwaye t = 5 inika ukuphakama kuka-−24, ngaphantsi komhlaba, ngoko ibhola isele ichukumise umhlaba.

z-m-23-04.prereq.0: I-H1 kulo msebenzi ibonisa kuphela ubunzima bolu didi lwemveliso; ayithethi ukuba ikharityhulam inikela esi sixhobo kwibanga lesikolo samabanga aphezulu elingu-1. Ulandelelwano lokufunda olucingelwayo: abafundi osele befunde ii-equation zekhwadratiki, ukungalingani kwekhwadratiki, nobudlelwane phakathi kwee-roots namakoyifishenti.
z-m-23-04.title: Itheyibhile yamaxabiso inganquma izisombululo ezipheleleyo ze-f(x) < 0?
z-m-23-04.topic: Ukugweba izisombululo ezipheleleyo zokungalingani kwekhwadrathi usebenzisa itheyibhile yamaxabiso nophawu lomsebenzi wekhwadrathi
z-m-23-04.goal: Gweba isisombululo sokungalingani kwekhwadrathi ngotshintsho lophawu kwitheyibhile yamaxabiso omsebenzi, hlela amabango angenakwenziwa ngetheyibhile yodwa, uze uchaze ukuba ziziphi iimeko ezigqiba isigqibo.
z-m-23-04.material:
Umsebenzi f(x) = ax² + bx + c ngumsebenzi wekhwadrathi apho isidibanisi se-x² a sikhulu kune-0, kodwa asiwazi amaxabiso ka-a, b, c. Sisazi kuphela itheyibhile yamaxabiso engezantsi, yaye onke ama-x etheyibhileni ngamanani aphelele.
x: −1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4
f(x): 3, −1, −3, −3, −1, 3
Umbuzo: Ngawaphi amanani aphelele x anelisa f(x) < 0? (Kwitheyibhile, umqolo ongasentla ngu-x yaye umqolo osezantsi lixabiso le-f(x), yaye amanani akwindawo enye abhangiswe.)
z-m-23-04.prereq.1: Imilo yegrafu yomsebenzi wekhwadrathi (uphawu luka-a nomkhombandlela ovula kuwo)
z-m-23-04.prereq.2: Ukudibana komsebenzi wekhwadrathi ne-x-axis, nesixhobo sokulinganisa
z-m-23-04.s.s1.prompt: Xa usebenzisa itheyibhile kuphela ungafumani ibinzana, yeyiphi intetho enokumiselwa malunga namanani aphelele x anelisa f(x) < 0?
z-m-23-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kwitheyibhile, phawula phakathi kwamaxabiso ka-x athini apho f itshintsha ukusuka kwi-positive ukuya kwi-negative nasekuyo-negative ukuya kwi-positive.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ngemilo yomsebenzi wekhwadrathi onga > 0, cinga ukuba ayakha ngapha iikhefu zamaxabiso x angaphantsi kwe-0, uze uthelekise namanani aphelele angaphandle kwetheyibhile.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.o.a: Kuphela ezimbini, i-1 ne-2. Zizo apho ixabiso lincinci kakhulu kwitheyibhile
z-m-23-04.s.s1.r.a: Olu gwebo lujonga kuphela apho ixabiso lincinci khona. f(x) < 0 ithetha onke ama-x anamaxabiso angaphantsi kwe-0.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.o.b: Onke amanani aphelele ayisithandathu etheyibhileni, ukusuka ku-−1 ukuya ku-4
z-m-23-04.s.s1.r.b: Olu gwebo lubona onke ama-x etheyibhileni njengezisombululo. Hlola kwakhona ukuba ikholamu enexabiso 3 inelisa f(x) < 0.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.o.c: 0, 1, 2, 3, kwaye amanani aphelele angaphandle kwetheyibhile akayizisombululo
z-m-23-04.s.s1.r.c: Olu gwebo lusebenzisa zombini utshintsho lophawu kwitheyibhile nemilo yomsebenzi wekhwadrathi.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.o.d: Amaxabiso anokuba negative nakumanani aphelele angaphandle kwetheyibhile, ngoko akunakumiselwa
z-m-23-04.s.s1.r.d: Olu gwebo lithi amaxabiso angekho kwitheyibhile awaziwa. Cinga ukuba imiqathango yokuba ngumsebenzi wekhwadrathi nokuba a > 0 ikuxelela ntoni ngangaphandle kwetheyibhile.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.explain: f(−1) = 3 > 0 kwaye f(0) = −1 < 0, ngoko uphawu lutshintsha phakathi kwe-−1 ne-0, yaye f(3) = −1 < 0 kwaye f(4) = 3 > 0, ngoko kutshintsha phakathi kwe-3 ne-4. Kumsebenzi wekhwadrathi onga > 0, ama-x anef(x) < 0 enza ikhefu e-1, ngoko isisombululo sisingaphakathi phakathi kwala manqaku mabini, yaye amanani aphelele ngu-0, 1, 2, 3. (Ukuba ufumana ibinzana f(x) = x² − 3x − 1 uze uhlole, ufumana isigqibo esifanayo.)
z-m-23-04.s.s2.prompt: Umfundi uqiqe ngolu hlobo lungezantsi esuka kwitheyibhile engentla. Khetha umgca ophosakeleyo, ibango elingenakwenziwa ngetheyibhile yodwa.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.hint.0: Hlukanisa ukuba umgca ngamnye uthetha okuthile ngamaxabiso abhaliweyo etheyibhileni kuphela okanye uthetha okuthile ngamaxabiso kwi-x engekho etheyibhileni.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ukusuka kwinyaniso f(1) = f(2), bhala ukuba igrafu iyalingana malunga ne-x yeyiphi, uze uthelekise ixabiso kuloo x namanye amaxabiso etheyibhileni.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.line.0: f(−1) = 3 > 0 kwaye f(0) = −1 < 0, ngoko uphawu lwexabiso le-f lutshintsha phakathi kwe-−1 ne-0.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.line.1: f(3) = −1 < 0 kwaye f(4) = 3 > 0, ngoko uphawu lutshintsha phakathi kwe-3 ne-4 nalo.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.line.2: Kumsebenzi wekhwadrathi onga > 0, ama-x anamaxabiso angaphantsi kwe-0 enza ikhefu e-1, ngoko elo khefu lilele phakathi kwamanqaku amabini angentla.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.line.3: Ngoko amanani aphelele x anef(x) < 0 ngu-0, 1, 2, 3.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.line.4: Kwakhona, f(1) = f(2) = −3, ngoko elona xabiso lincinci le-f ngu-−3.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.explain: Umgca o-5 uphosakele. Awukwazi ukuthi ixabiso elincinci ujonge kuphela amaxabiso kumanani aphelele x. Ukuba f(1) = f(2), isixhobo sokulinganisa ngu-x = 1.5 yaye elona lincinci livela apho. Kule theyibhile, f(x) = x² − 3x − 1, ngoko f(1.5) = −3.25, encinci kune-−3. Imigca ukusuka ku-1 ukuya ku-4 inokuthethwa ngokuchanekileyo usebenzisa itheyibhile nomqathango a > 0 kuphela.
z-m-23-04.s.s3.prompt: Ukuba itheyibhile engentla yodwa yayinikiwe, ngaphandle komqathango "umsebenzi wekhwadrathi onga > 0", ungamisela ukuba u-0, 1, 2, 3 ngamanani aphelele kuphela anef(x) < 0? Bhala isizathu nolwazi olufunekayo ukumisela.
z-m-23-04.s.s3.hint.0: Cinga ukuba amaxabiso anokuba nantoni na phakathi kwamanani aphelele x etheyibhileni (phakathi kwe-1 ne-2) nangaphandle kwetheyibhile (5 okanye ngaphezulu), uze ucinge iimeko apho amanani aphelele anef(x) < 0 anyuka.
z-m-23-04.s.s3.hint.1: Jonga umva ukuba ngawaphi amagwebo asebenzise umqathango "umsebenzi wekhwadrathi onga > 0" kumanyathelo angaphambili.
z-m-23-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubhale ukuba yintoni eyahlukileyo phakathi kokuba nomqathango wokuba ngumsebenzi wekhwadrathi nokungabikho kwawo?
z-m-23-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ucinge ngokukodwa ukuba amaxabiso anokuba yintoni phakathi kweengeniso zetheyibhile (phakathi kwe-1 ne-2) okanye ngaphandle kwetheyibhile (5 okanye ngaphezulu, −2 okanye ngaphantsi)?
z-m-23-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ubhale ubuncinane ulwazi olunye olufunekayo ukumisela?
z-m-23-04.s.s3.model.0: Akunakumiselwa. Itheyibhile ibonisa amaxabiso kumanani aphelele ambalwa kuphela, ngoko andazi ukuba amaxabiso atshintsha njani phakathi kwe-1 ne-2 okanye ngaphandle kwetheyibhile (5 okanye ngaphezulu). Kuphela ngomqathango wokuba ngumsebenzi wekhwadrathi onga>0 singathi ikhefu apho ingu-negative likhefu e-1.
z-m-23-04.s.s3.model.1: Hayi. Ukuba ayingomsebenzi wekhwadrathi kodwa ngomnye umsebenzi odlula kumanqaku etheyibhile, inokuba negative kwiindawo ezinje ngo-5 okanye −2, kwaye inokunyuka ibe positive phakathi kwe-1 ne-2. Singamisela kuphela ngomqathango wokuba ngumsebenzi wekhwadrathi okanye ngamaxabiso amaninzi angaphandle kwetheyibhile.
z-m-23-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Inike namaxabiso angaphandle kwetheyibhile njengolwazi olongezelelweyo.
